# GLee 5.4

The OpenGL extension loader that the game links in. Copyright 2009 Ben Woodhouse, modified BSD license (see `readme.txt`). Do not edit these files.

- Source: `glee_5.4.0.orig.tar.gz` from the Ubuntu archive (`https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/universe/g/glee/`). The official site (elf-stone.com) asks for a password today.
- SHA-256 of the tarball: `3b58430172392ec75acdad5fd833ecf494c5518382bc27932f48d46dbb01cd29` (it matches the `.dsc` file of the package).
- Files here: `GLee.c`, `GLee.h`, `extensionList.txt`, `readme.txt`. The other files of the tarball (`configure`, `Makefile.in`, `config.h.in`, `install-sh`) are not needed.
- Why this version: see `docs/glee.md`.
